title: Introduce metadata-accordion and autodigest release composer
author: Elliot Park
release_notes: Adds two complementary features: a compact 'metadata-accordion' serializer to collapse unchanged nested metadata into a delta-friendly view; an 'autodigest' release composer that synthesizes concise changelog entries from metadata deltas and perf signatures; CLI flag --autodigest to enable auto-release notes; onboarding preview updates to surface compact digests; no breaking changes; migration hook provided for legacy profile hashes.
description: Motivation: onboarding churn often produces noisy, sprawling changelogs and makes diffs hard to scan for reviewers. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: metadata-accordion, a schema-aware delta compressor that collapses unchanged nested metadata and surfaces compact, auditable deltas; and autodigest, a release composer that converts those deltas plus lightweight performance signatures into human-friendly release notes. Goals: reduce reviewer noise, keep per-variant release blurbs concise, preserve provenance for rollbacks, and surface relevant perf deltas (p50/p95/cost) automatically. What changed: added a metadata accordion ingest path that emits a compact delta record instead of full nested blobs; added delta_serializer to canonicalize field-level diffs and stable keys; added autodigest templates and signer hook to generate draft release notes on model intake; updated onboarding preview UI to show the compact digest and provide an inline "accept release blurb" flow; added a CLI flag --autodigest to opt in for automated release generation; migration helper to map legacy profile hashes to compact fingerprints. Checklist: - [x] Implement accordion serializer and canonical delta format; - [x] Implement autodigest composer and templates; - [x] Add unit tests for numeric rounding and field-level retention semantics; - [x] Add integration tests for onboarding preview and CI pipeline; - [x] Add docs and migration notes; - [x] Run perf sampling to ensure no added latency in ingest path; Commits: 1) d3f4a7b: add metadata-accordion core serializer and delta format; 2) a1b2c3d: implement autodigest templates and signing hook; 3) b2c3d4e: onboarding preview UI and CLI flag; 4) c3d4e5f: tests and docs; Changed areas (high-level): ingest pipeline (new accordion step and delta_serializer); release writer (autodigest, signer hook); onboarding preview web UI; CLI opt-in; docs and migration script; tests. Diff snippet (illustrative): "- full_profile: {layers: [...], tags: {...}} + delta_profile: {tags: {added: [\"safety_label\"], removed: []}, perf: {p95_delta: +10ms}}" Review conversation: Liam O'Connor: "Can the autodigest include a token-cost estimate and the 95th latency delta? The digest should be stable across minor numeric noise; consider rounding rules." Elliot Park (author): "Added p95 and token-cost summarization and a deterministic rounding policy (p95 -> nearest 5ms, cost -> microcurrency rounding) and corresponding unit tests." Ravi Menon: "How does this interact with existing profile hash contract? We must avoid automated releases that break pinned variants." Elliot Park: "Added a compatibility shim in profile_hash_compat.py and a migration hook that emits a warning and preserves old fingerprints for pinned variants; autodigest will not publish automatic rollouts for variants with pins without explicit approval." Sofia Alvarez: "Docs look good; please add a short runbook for rollback steps." Elliot Park: "Added docs/model-onboard/autodigest.md with rollback steps and a CLI helper to revert autodigest entries." CI and testing: initial CI run reported lint failure in metadata_accordion.py (unused import) and one flaky ingest integration scenario. Fixes applied in followup commits: removed unused import and stabilized the ingest test by adding deterministic timestamps for sample fixtures. Final CI run: all checks passed. Performance: ingest path adds <6ms median overhead on sample workloads; sampled rollout shows no measurable token cost increase. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag 'autodigest' for 10% of intakes for 72h, then 50% for additional 5 days, full rollout pending telemetry. Migration: provided scripts/scripts/release/generate_digest.sh and profile_hash_compat.py to rehydrate historic releases into compact digests. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; autodigest is opt-in and autodraft is only published when signer hook is enabled. Merge: merged via squash by Sofia Alvarez on 2025-09-12, merge commit d3f4a7b9c8e2a1f5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7. Notes: this PR should materially reduce changelog noise for model onboard events and provide a more reviewer-friendly digest for release notes while retaining provenance and rollback safety.
